'''Iohara no Kuni no Miyatsuko''' (廬原国造; also read Iohara Kokuzō) were the [[kuni no miyatsuko]] who governed the western part of [[Suruga Province]]. They are also known as the Iohara no Kuni no Miyatsuko (五百原国造).

__TOC__
{{clear}}

== Overview ==

The ''[[Sendai Kuji Hongi]]'' ("Kokuzo Hongi") records the name as '''Iohara no Kuni no Miyatsuko''' (廬原国造), also written as '''Iohara no Kuni no Miyatsuko''' (庵原国造).

=== Ancestry ===
* According to the ''[[Kojiki]]'', [[Hikozashikatawake no Mikoto]], a prince of [[Emperor Kōrei]], is listed as the ancestor of the Iohara no Kimi, and is considered to be of the same lineage as the Tonami clan of Koshi and the Kunitaki clan of [[Toyokuni Province|Buzen Province]].
* According to the [[Sendai Kuji Hongi]]'s "Kokuzo Hongi," [[Shikabehiko no Mikoto]], son of [[Kibino Takehiko no Mikoto]] (ancestor of the Ikeda Sakai no Kimi), is recorded as the ancestor of the Iohara no Kuni no Miyatsuko.
* According to the ''[[Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'', the ancestor was [[Wakitakehiko no Mikoto]], a prince of Emperor Kōrei, and the clan is considered to be of the same lineage as the Kasa clan.

=== Clan ===

The clan was known as the '''Iohara clan''' (廬原氏; kabane: Kimi, Kō), also written as the Iohara no Kimi (五百原君). Some members later received the kabane of Ason.

== Home Territory ==

The exact base of the kuni no miyatsuko is unknown. However, place names such as Iohara-chō survive in [[Shimizu Ward, Shizuoka|Shimizu Ward]], and the [[Miikehira Kofun]] and [[Tookagosha Shrine, Shizuoka|Toyoakari Shrine]] are found in the vicinity.

=== Sphere of Rule ===

The sphere of rule of the kuni no miyatsuko covered the area then known as Iohara no Kuni (廬原国), which later became Iohara District (廬原郡), part of [[Suruga Province]]. It is believed to have covered the area centered on present-day [[Shimizu Ward, Shizuoka|Shimizu Ward]], [[Shizuoka City]], between the [[Fuji River|Fujikawa]] and [[Ōi River|Ōikawa]] rivers.

== Clan Deity ==

Located in the former Iohara District and ranked as the Second Shrine (Ninomiya) of Suruga Province: [[Toyotsumi Shrine]] and [[Toyouke Shrine (Shizuoka)|Toyouke Shrine]].

=== Associated Shrines ===
* [[Yakura Shrine]]
*: Said to originate from the enshrinement of [[Yamato Takeru]] and [[Emperor Keikō]] by Ikabehiko no Mikoto during the reign of [[Emperor Chūai]].
* [[Kusanagi Shrine]]
*: An ancient shrine associated with the eastern campaign of [[Yamato Takeru]], once known by the epithet "ninety-eight thousand shrines" (九万八千社).
* [[Toyouke Shrine (Shizuoka)|Toyouke Shrine]]
*: Said to originate from the eastern campaign of [[Yamato Takeru]] and the associated burial mound cluster of the Iohara clan.

=== Tombs ===
* '''Goōdōyama Kofun No. 3''' (午王堂山3号墳)
*: A zenpō-kōhō-fun (square-rear keyhole mound) 78 meters in length located in [[Shimizu Ward, Shizuoka|Shimizu Ward]], [[Shizuoka City]], constructed in the latter half of the 4th century. Due to its construction date, it is considered to be the tomb of the first ancestor of the Iohara no Kuni no Miyatsuko.
* '''Miikehira Kofun''' (三池平古墳)
*: A zenpō-kōen-fun (round-rear keyhole mound) 68 meters in length located in Shimizu Ward, Shizuoka City, constructed in the early 5th century. It is considered second in antiquity to Goōdōyama Kofun No. 3.
* '''Shinmeiyama Kofun No. 1''' (神明山1号墳)
*: A zenpō-kōen-fun 72 meters in length located in Shimizu Ward, Shizuoka City. Designed to one-quarter the scale of the [[Hashihaka Kofun]] in [[Sakurai, Nara|Sakurai City]], [[Nara Prefecture]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=神明山古墳 |url=https://www.city.shizuoka.lg.jp/s6725/s005188.html |website=静岡市 |access-date=2025-05-20 |language=ja |last=静岡市}}</ref> it was constructed in the latter half of the 3rd century.<ref>{{Cite web |title=しずおか文化財ナビ 神明山1号墳・神明山4号墳｜静岡県公式ホームページ |url=https://www.pref.shizuoka.jp/kankosports/bunkageijutsu/bunkazai/1002825/1041003/1041886/1004975/1021167.html |website=静岡県公式ホームページ |access-date=2025-05-20 |language=ja}}</ref>
* '''Yazuyama Kofun''' (谷津山古墳)
*: A zenpō-kōen-fun 110 meters in length located in [[Aoi Ward, Shizuoka|Aoi Ward]], [[Shizuoka City]], constructed in the 4th century.

== Descendants ==
* [[Iohara no Omi|廬原臣]]
*: A military commander during the reign of [[Emperor Tenji]]. He commanded the naval forces alongside [[Abe no Hirafu]] at the [[Battle of Baekgang]] (663 CE), but was defeated.
